profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary: Software developer and IT analyst with business knowledge in the oil and gas industry.  Expert at assessing problems, defining and developing IT solutions, through to project completion, including testing, training and maintenance.   Versatile, driven and enjoy working with people.    Proven track record in delivering good results and meeting deadlines.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Aa a member of the Platform team, I was required to help transition from a monolith application to a microservices based architecture.   Based in .NET Core using C# with Entity Frameworks (EF) for the data layer.  

Azure Service Bus Queues and Topics is used to facilitate messaging across our microservices by creating events.   Employed Azure functions to process events for subscribed services.   Maintained Azure Application Gateway and APIM which exposes our endpoints securely.  

To facilitate fast and consistent rollout to the product teams, the Platform team created Visual Studio templates using best practices.

Wrote yaml scripts for Azure DevOps CI/CD.   As a policy, deployment and resource allocation should only be achieved via merge requests.  For example, EF Data Migrations to deploy database changes. Azure AppConfig / KeyVault is used to store our configuration information and secure connection strings.  Recently moved to from Azure DevOps to GitLab / Terraform.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Part of a team developing core web application based on a Microservices architecture, and single page applications (SPA).   Using .NET Core, EF Core, and Angular.   Adept with Git, Azure DevOps, Visual Studio 2019 and RabbitMQ.   

Despite working remotely most of the time, I engaged well with the team, and quickly became a contributing member.   Participated in code reviews, and where appropriate, pair programming (via Teams).

positions.title: Senior Developer, Applications
positions.description:
Deliver technical solutions using re-usable artifacts, for example a REST based API to create/delete Active Directory accounts and to reset passwords.

Efficient and engaging, teams become better focused when I contribute insight into real world implementation challenges and recommend capabilities that drive greater value from use.   Consistent track record of overcoming ‘showstopper’ issues to deliver reliable solutions. 
 
Manage application performance issues by establishing baselines, database tuning, and best practice application development.  Troubleshoot hard-to-identify application performance issues with WireShark and Fiddler.

Database administration and development:
•	Built, maintain and troubleshoot SQL Server Merge and Transactional replication
•	Built complex views, stored procedures and queries with Common Table Expressions (CTEs) 
•	Found more efficient methods to manage SQL Server instances across the fleet world-wide by using SQL Server Central Management Console.

positions.title: Technical Analyst II
positions.description:
Develop and maintain the applications of Rowan, using Silverlight, XAML, on an MVVM framework and Telerik controls.    For errors that could not be reproduced in the development or test environment, used Visual Studio Remote Debugger to identify and resolve problems specific to the client environment.

Automated data integration between applications with BizTalk Orchestrations and WCF services.

Designed solutions using task-based, async and parallel programming model available in .NET 4 and Silverlight 5.

positions.title: Software Developer / Network Administrator
positions.description: Supported iBis (iMed Business Information System), the in-house coding and billing system specific to anesthesia.  Leveraged in-depth understanding of end-to-end customer experience to identify pain points and latent customer needs.

positions.title: Systems Designer
positions.description:
- Software Developer.  Primarily developed software in C#, with some experience with VB.   Moved quickly from prototyping to enterprise-quality robust implementations using frameworks such as MVC, WCF and WPF.   Used Object-Relational Mapping (ORM) technologies such as Nhibernate and Entity Frameworks. 
Built sophisticated and interactive reports using the SAP Crystal Reports module.  Used JQuery, JavaScript and CSS to enhance the user experience and aesthetics of web-based application.   Collaborated with designers to create clean interfaces and simple, intuitive interactions and experiences.

- Business Analysis.  Proficient in writing Statement of Requirements (SOR), Use Cases, User Guides and other technical documentation.   Continually established clear operational specifications and formulated software requirements.   Where appropriate, employed Unified Modelling Language (UML), State Diagrams, Flowcharts, Entity-Relationship Diagrams (ERD), Data Flow Diagrams (DFDs) and Sequence Diagrams

company.name: Amor Group a Lockheed Martin Company

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Designated the Focal Point for the GoPlan planning software.  Worked closely with customer in developing the software using C# and SQL Server 2005 tools.  Built sophisticated reports using SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS).

positions.title: Desktop Analyst
positions.description:
Log tickets using BMC Remedy Action Request System and after problem identification, provided assistance for a solution.  Troubleshooting problems such as Windows 2003, XP, Maximo, Citrix MetaFrame client setup, LiveLink, and SAP.

Single Point of Contact (SPoC) for IT related issues in accordance to the Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) process in capturing data.

company.name: Amor Group, a Lockheed Martin company

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Maintained code for the Guidance of Certification (GOC) software and part of the development team for GoPlan planning system, using C#, VB, SQL Server 2005 .
